diagnosis.plain_en: The gearbox or drive shaft is running hotter and rougher than normal, often from worn gear teeth or low oil.
diagnosis.plain_ms: Kotak gear atau aci pemacu lebih panas dan kasar daripada biasa, selalunya kerana gigi gear haus atau minyak rendah.

fingerprint.observed_en: Up 7% compared with normal, in the last 5 days
fingerprint.observed_ms: Naik 7% berbanding biasa dalam 5 hari lepas

fingerprint.observed_en: Down 2% compared with normal, in the last 5 days
fingerprint.observed_ms: Turun 2% berbanding biasa dalam 5 hari lepas

fingerprint.observed_en: Not yet: no clear change compared with normal (-0%)
fingerprint.observed_ms: Belum lagi: tiada perubahan jelas berbanding biasa (-0%)

steps_en: Check the gearbox oil level and take an oil sample.
Look for metal particles on the magnetic plug.
At the stop, check shaft alignment and coupling bolts.
Change the gear oil and filter; inspect gear teeth through the inspection port.
Replace the gear set or shaft if damage is found; log the findings.
steps_ms: Semak paras minyak kotak gear dan ambil sampel minyak.
Cari serpihan logam pada palam magnet.
Pada waktu henti, semak penjajaran aci dan bolt gandingan.
Tukar minyak gear dan penapis; periksa gigi gear melalui lubang pemeriksaan.
Tukar set gear atau aci jika rosak; catat penemuan.
